Filtering `eligible_primary == "1"` gives 353 admitted families (173 dark, 180 control), and summing `n_species_complete_window` across those 353 families derives exactly 877 candidate loci.

- **H4 Pooled Group & Recovery Rate:** Derived directly from [`v7_stratum_census.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round7_final/h4/v7_stratum_census.tsv) across primary `tier_1` by pooling $K_{\text{local\_pdb}} + K_{\text{local\_afdb\_only}} + K_{\text{dual\_none}}$ ($849 + 87 + 95 = 1,031$ models; $812 + 84 + 88 = 984$ eligible models; $796 + 82 + 86 = 964$ whole-chain absences; $586 + 62 + 66 = 714$ crop recoveries; $714 / 964 = 74.07\%$).

### 4. Audit Trail for Obsolete alnTM Claims Removal

Foldseek's 0-indexed alignment length normalisation bug (`min(qspan - 1, tspan - 1)` missing `+ 1`) produced non-physical `alnTM` scores up to 1.014 in 2,194 rows across 6.85 million lines. Because sub-1.0 scores are also unpredictably distorted by this bug, rescaled `alnTM` claims were rejected per Root's scientific disposition, and all structural classifications rely strictly on query-normalised TM (`qTM`).

The following 8 obsolete active claims were removed from `reproducibility/verify.py`:
- Candidate: `b1a.alntm.qualified` (97.0), `b1a.alntm.qualified_pct` (5.17%), `b1a.alntm.qualified.no_rows` (74.0), `b1a.alntm.qualified.low` (23.0).
- Known-Fold Control: `b1a.control.alntm.qualified` (68.0), `b1a.control.alntm.pct` (2.26%), `b1a.control.alntm.no_rows` (66.0), `b1a.control.alntm.low` (2.0).
